purpose: Teach: 小冊子/鉄骨/凝縮/収める/経済学部/新株/チャーター/リクルート

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究紹介の小冊子を作れ
lines.en: Ren, put together a research introduction pamphlet.
lines.style: Direct, clipped delivery. No warmth, no harshness—just the next task. Efficient exhale on the name. Assumes competence and obedience without needing to state either.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の鉄骨補強工事中です
lines.en: Yes. The lab is currently in the middle of structural reinforcement work.
lines.style: Careful, slightly defensive. Pacing that shows he's selecting each word. Quiet earnestness—not overexplaining, but wanting the boss to understand the constraint. Small breath before the last clause.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文を凝縮してプレゼンしろ
lines.en: Ren, condense that paper into a presentation.
lines.style: Efficient command. Matter-of-fact, no inflection needed. The tone of someone who's already two steps ahead and trusting you to catch up. Slight emphasis on the directness of the verb.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費を予算内に収める努力をしております
lines.en: Yes. I'm working to keep the research budget within our allocation.
lines.style: Formal, slightly strained politeness underneath. Demonstrates he's already thinking ahead—showing initiative before being asked. Steady pace, careful emphasis on effort over excuse. A hint of worry he's hiding behind 'working to.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、経済学部の共同研究にも参加しろ
lines.en: Ren, join in the joint research project with the Economics Department too.
lines.style: Another task, same efficient tone. Stacked expectations—no drama, just the assumption that he'll manage. Brief pause after his name, then onward. Composed authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。新株発行の事例を経済論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I've already covered new share issuance cases in an economics paper.
lines.style: Slightly lifted—pride in preparedness breaking through the formality. Demonstrating he's already ahead. Measured pace, but a small note of relief that he can say yes to this one without excuse.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外学会のチャーター便も活用しろ
lines.en: Ren, make use of the international conference charter flights as well.
lines.style: The fourth direction in quick succession. Still composed, still assumptive. A beat of finality—this is the last one, and it lands differently. Efficiency turning into something slightly more resolute.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会のリクルートブースに参加します
lines.en: Yes. I'll participate in the conference recruitment booth.
lines.style: Acceptance closing the loop. Quieter now—not defeated, but moving into compliance. A small acknowledgment that he's absorbed the weight of all four assignments. Steady, professional close.
